description: Search and filter the person's ShearQuery CRM contacts: by text, tag, who's reachable on a channel (email, sms…), and whether they're a ShearQuery member or a directory listing. Returns the total that match and a page of contacts with ids. With no filters it also lists the most-used tags. Use it to answer "how many…" questions and to get contact ids for the other crm_ tools.

linked.description: member = a ShearQuery member; listing = a directory listing; none = neither.

query.description: Search name, email, phone, company or city.

reachable.description: Only contacts who have that address and aren't Do Not Disturb on it.

name: crm_contacts
title: Search my contacts
